question: In a certain code language, 'JPMNO" is coded as ‘73562', ‘AMNBD' is coded as '28954', 'JNACQ' is coded as '12430'. What is the code for 'B' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : No specific pattern is followed here, random codes are assigned to each letter.

So,

 
• 'JPMNO" is coded as ‘73562'
 
• ‘AMNBD' is coded as '28954'
 
• 'JNACQ' is coded as '12430'

As some letters are common, so the codes will be :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4902a67fb5bab28b5accb3d900c8a15c9610c04cb3a6f55cee69f8572be239b8.png] 

​Therefore,

 
• 'B' will be coded as either 8 or 9.

As, out of all only options option - (2) is '8', thus 'B' is coded as '8'.

​Hence, "8" is the correct answer.
